issues.title: Send new message without input, it will get the same content which the last message
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Send new message without input, it will get the same content which the last message

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
1. Playgame with role Blue- Blue 3rd Party
2. Send the first message with some input content
3. Send the second new message without input infor message
4. Notice the second message has same content with the first message

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Send new message without input should not get the same content which the last message

## 🖥️ Screenscast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/6bc21dc3-ed5b-4492-b539-b43c9a475b0c



## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome


## 📝 Additional context
